title: Assert with a Message
prompt: Write validate_age(age): raise AssertionError('age must be an int') when age is not an int (booleans are NOT ints here), AssertionError('age out of range') when outside 0..150, and return the string ok otherwise.

tests.name: asserts fire correctly
tests.code:
assert validate_age(30) == "ok"
try:
    validate_age("30")
    _ok = False
except AssertionError as e:
    _ok = True
    assert "int" in str(e), f"message must mention int, got {e}"
assert _ok, "str must raise AssertionError"

_raised = False
try:
    validate_age(True)
except AssertionError:
    _raised = True
assert _raised, "bool must raise (bool is not an int here)"

try:
    validate_age(200)
    _ok2 = False
except AssertionError as e:
    _ok2 = True
    assert "range" in str(e), f"message must mention range, got {e}"
assert _ok2, "200 must raise AssertionError"
tests.hint: isinstance(age, bool) check FIRST (bool is a subclass of int!), then isinstance(age, int), then 0 <= age <= 150.
